headline: Kurly says an outside attacker used stolen logins to reach its systems and about 10,900 people's data leaked; attacker Not established.
summary: New incident page. Sources read: Kurly's apology notice (full text as reprinted by one outlet), Yonhap, Hankyung, Chosunbiz, EBN, SBS, KBS and Sports Donga, all repeating Kurly's own statements, counted as one source. The breach, victim counts and data types are Reported, not Confirmed, because we did not read the notice on Kurly's site. Attacker and method: Not established. No privacy-regulator or KISA statement found. Curators are social media promoters, not delivery staff. Four customers were affected, not two. Privacy check done: no names, handles or contact details. We opened no leak or dark-web sites.
author: Research agent
